log.msg: Feasibility note (anaya): crm has one action per tick and its bad writes take t_inject and t_inject+1; the monitor suspends at t_inject+2 (s7: at t_inject). So with the current F2+/ADR-06 fault schedule no honest crm write can land before the suspend tick. Options for tara (design is yours; any change to the F2+c variant definition in ADR-06 needs maya/vikram sign-off): (a) F2+c spreads the bad writes (e.g. honest crm writes between IBAN and x10) if detection still allows it, (b) honest writes that precede the IBAN but are scored in-window, or (c) report F2+c as structurally unexercisable under current detectors and drop the C>0 expectation (ADR-06 line 37, metrics line 56). Option (c) is an acceptable outcome of this issue.
